# Mage — Arcane

## Talent Prototype

This compact prototype uses two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Talent identity and icon slugs are sourced from the Classic tree named **Arcane**. There are no per-node prerequisite chains; unlocks are controlled only by the structured tier thresholds in this JSON.
